{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''elixir''' was developed by the [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]]. It was made from the tail scales of the ferocious [[Horax/Legends|horax]]. The elixir was used to create a barrier of defense around Nelvaanian [[City/Legends|villages]], as horaxes were scared of the scent. One scale could produce a strong enough elixir to protect a village for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], and so it became a rite of passage for [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Nelvaanian [[Gender/Legends|boys]] to venture out and take a scale off the tail of a sleeping horax at the beginning of every year.
